model_change: User requested deepseek-v4-pro on 2026-09-10 after the v4.1-flash endpoint changed. Use the explicit pro model ID; preserve checkpoints and bounded concurrency. Pause after repeated endpoint failures rather than switching silently.

acceptance.compiled: Correct package cwd, lake build, per-file checks, source hashes. This is NOT proof completion.
acceptance.kernel_audited: Programmatic dependency-axiom audit of every new declaration, with fail-closed negative controls; only propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound permitted.
acceptance.semantically_reviewed: Independent review of expanded theorem types, domains, quantified hypotheses, definitions and non-vacuity; models and conditional implications labeled explicitly.
acceptance.blocker_closed: An existing named missing input is constructed under the original intended geometric assumptions, consumed by a downstream theorem, and independently rebuilt. A new alias, Prop, projection or stronger hypothesis does not close a blocker.

checkpoints.goal: Dependency search and first compiling lemma or exact failing Lean goal; classify statement defects before trying to prove them.
A useful nontrivial lemma with full type, source hash, compile log and axiom evidence; otherwise checkpoint the precise obstruction.
Concrete downstream use or reviewed subproblem decomposition, not a promise that a theorem is proved.
Review each track; accept closed sublemmas or preserve partial results with TASK_BLOCKED. Never auto-accept mathematical completion.
Independent integrated rebuild and critical-path re-estimate; no commitment to complete Perelman by this date.

tasks.objective: Repair the D7 initial-condition domain, not the heat equation. Read D11 HeatKernelBridge: all continuous functions on noncompact Euclidean space is overstrong. Define a versioned admissible-test-function interface (continuous compact support or an explicitly suitable integrable class), prove the D11 Euclidean core inhabits it for every dimension, and prove precisely scoped compatibility for compact finite-measure settings. Do not assume FullInitialCondition in positive dimension; do not replace genuine Laplacians by arbitrary operators. Keep legacy definitions unchanged until downstream compatibility is proved. If feasible formalize an explicit fast-growing counterexample to the old condition; label the informal obstruction separately until then.

Starting from D10 Gaussian mass/convolution and D11 initial convergence where available, prove a genuine Euclidean heat-operator estimate on a specified function space: first positivity and L-infinity contraction, then L1 contraction or strong continuity with all measurability/integrability obligations. Use Lebesgue measure and the explicit kernel. Establish one smoothing or differentiation-under-integral lemma if feasible. Do not label Euclidean results as manifold heat-kernel existence. Design the next compact-manifold construction as explicit proof obligations only after the model theorem is checked.

Work toward genuine short-time PDE existence. Inspect mathlib ODE, Banach fixed point, function-space and D9 DeTurck/ParabolicEstimates APIs. Construct a nontrivial heat-semigroup mild solution or contraction argument on a precisely defined Banach space with verified bounds, rather than finite-dimensional ODE relabeling. Prove the exact bridge obligations for a semilinear parabolic model. Identify the derivative loss and quasilinear regularity barriers to Ricci-DeTurck, never assume the target existence theorem as a field. Research existing open-source formalizations with exact license/revision before reuse; no wholesale import of admitted proofs.

Trace D3/D7 entropy objects to definitions. Prove one missing analytic step for a genuine integral functional: differentiation of time-dependent weighted integrals under explicit regularity/domination, or a concrete F/W derivative identity on a proved nontrivial model. Correctly distinguish increasing Perelman F from the old nonincreasing toy functional. Integrability, normalization and time-dependent measure obligations must appear. Do not use FDerivativeStatement or monotonicity as an assumed field and call that a closure. Preserve original definitions and state exact geometric restrictions.

Develop a useful sublemma for reduced length, reduced-volume or entropy-to-noncollapsing. Start by checking D7 Reduced/Kappa and D11 ReducedVolume sources. Prove an actual curve-energy bound/minimizer or Gaussian reduced-volume normalization using a real curve/function space; not an arbitrary Prop certificate. If already available, prove one quantitative estimate required for the general argument and identify its geometric assumptions. Separate model-space calculation, conditional transfer and general theorem. Do not infer canonical neighborhoods or ancient-solution classification from a formal record.

Connect actual metric/connection geometry to D7 tensor data. Inspect LeviCivita, covariant derivatives, D7 curvature and D9 tensor algebra. Prove one substantive theorem constructing the smooth Levi-Civita connection or curvature from metric coefficients on a real chart, with a correctly proved coordinate transformation/naturality or contraction statement. Begin with a nonconstant smooth metric example if needed, but record that it is a model. Do not assume the desired tensor identities in the structure used to prove them. Derive one downstream Ricci/scalar identity with theorem provenance.

Build the measure/geometry bridge: actual Riemannian density from a positive-definite metric matrix, regularity/measurability, and one chart change-of-variables or integration-by-parts statement with compact support. Compare existing mathlib orientation/volume APIs rather than assuming their absence from an old ledger. Prove at least one nontrivial identity consumed by the entropy or Bochner chain. A supplied measure named volume and an assumed divergence theorem are not a construction. Keep global manifold/Stokes gaps explicit.

Audit D11 maximum principle/Bochner outputs and develop a genuine missing tensor-calculus step. Prioritize a first/second derivative identity for a metric-compatible covariant derivative, or a matrix positivity preservation lemma with the correct tangent-cone condition and time regularity. Distinguish scalar/semidiscrete estimates from Hamilton's tensor maximum principle on manifolds. Use a constructed connection/Laplacian on the claimed domain. List all assumptions and prove a downstream application not obtained solely by projection from an assumed conclusion.

Turn one spectral/Sobolev prerequisite into a theorem: inspect D11 SpectralTorus and mathlib Fourier/AddCircle/Sobolev APIs. Prove a genuine Poincare inequality, compact embedding sublemma, or heat spectral-series convergence on an explicit torus/domain, with dimensions, constants and norms specified. Do not replace an infinite series by a finite sum and claim the infinite result. If blocked, isolate the exact analytic estimate and prove supporting finite/infinite limit lemmas. General compact manifolds remain outside scope until a chart/partition argument is supplied.

Independent adversarial audit of the available D1-D11 snapshot. Enumerate each claimed main-chain theorem, expand all certificate/record fields, classify as model, conditional, statement-only, or genuine general theorem. Validate D11 heat test-function defect and D7 recognition assumptions. Recount blockers from evidence: do not repeat '22 blockers' or claim research-level new mathematical discoveries. Produce machine-readable ledger with full declaration types, source hashes, axiom cones, precise dependencies and which inputs were actually constructed. Add a Lean audit module that checks relevant declarations; never weaken or modify builder sources. Existing historical audit manifests must not be presented as current.

Move beyond constant-curvature formulas toward a comparison lemma. Inspect D10 Jacobi and D11 ComparisonModels; prove a nonconstant scalar Jacobi/Riccati comparison with correct interval, positivity, initial conditions and no division at zero. If feasible connect it to a genuine variational/geodesic quantity, not an arbitrarily named density. Separate ODE comparison from general Rauch/Bishop-Gromov. Derive one rigorous volume-ratio consequence under fully expanded analytic hypotheses and list what geometric construction is still missing.

Inspect actual mathlib Gromov-Hausdorff and metric compactness definitions and D7/D9 certificates. Construct a nontrivial compactness/precompactness theorem from uniform covering-number or equicontinuity estimates using genuine metric spaces. Supply subsequence/convergence witnesses and point out the missing smooth/gauge/curvature steps for Cheeger-Gromov. Do not prove compactness by assuming a record containing a convergent subsequence. Design ancient-kappa/canonical-neighborhood dependencies as the next proof frontier without claiming those theorems.

Advance a real topology prerequisite after inspecting D8 Moise bridge and D10/D11 triangulation modules. Prove a concrete geometric-realization/homeomorphism statement for a finite complex or a gluing/covering lemma needed by sphere recognition, with actual topological spaces. Audit dimensions and compactness/nonemptiness conventions. Moise for arbitrary topological 3-manifolds remains a separate task: a triangulated input or a definition called Triangulable is not its proof. Research reusable topology libraries with license/revision records. Give a precise dependency DAG for the general Moise/smoothing branch.

Expand RecognitionHypotheses, ExtinctionCertificate, ConnectedSumDecomposition and SphericalPieceRecognition. Prove one substantive topology/geometry lemma that replaces an assumed field (e.g. a correct covering-space recognition or connected-sum simple-connectivity implication) with an actual construction. Existing 'sphere_of_spheres' and 'recognize' fields are assumptions, not proofs. If unavailable, formalize the smallest nontrivial prerequisite and a reviewed decomposition of neck estimates, surgery existence, finite extinction and final topology. Do not conflate an abstract well-founded decreasing complexity with extinction of an actual Ricci flow.

followup.objective: After all D12 terminal reports (including blocked) are available, independently rebuild a collision-checked integrated snapshot from sources with a fresh project build directory and pinned mathlib. Audit all new declarations and intentional negative controls. Never edit builder mathematics to make audit pass.

Review full expanded theorem statements, downstream use and the blocker ledger. Report which exact missing inputs were eliminated, which remain, and a critical-path ETA based on observed useful lemmas and unresolved serial dependencies, not task/file counts. Full Perelman completion remains unestimated unless every remaining dependency has an evidenced plan.
